common_boundaries.source_version_scope: Primary documentation read on the assessment date; mutable links unless an exact commit is in the URL. Pin the actual release before later use.
common_boundaries.cost: No purchase price does not imply zero hosting, storage, compute, provider, maintenance or edition cost.
common_boundaries.authority: Head Chef leads. This reference grants no install, task, credential, signing, deployment, live run or retry authority.

tools.documented: Web search, scraping/crawling, Markdown, HTML and structured output.
tools.proposed_use: One bounded source extractor when the existing approved reader is insufficient; preserve permitted originals and separately identified derivatives.
tools.boundary: Not source truth, access bypass, trusted-reader replacement or permission to act on page instructions.
tools.license: Primarily AGPL-3.0; SDKs and some UI components MIT; cloud/provider terms separate.
tools.gates: Pin edition/release; allow domains and redirects; cap pages/time/bytes/cost; block private-network destinations; isolate untrusted content; keep agent/interact actions off.
tools.proposed_test: One permitted page versus the current reader: preserve source/citations/omissions; deny an unapproved redirect and an injected instruction with zero effects; measure quality, latency and cost.

tools.documented: Speech recognition, language identification and translation; model card warns of words absent from the audio.
tools.proposed_use: Timestamp-linked transcript drafts for permitted audio; keep original media, model/configuration identity and verified critical passages.
tools.boundary: Not verified quotations, speaker identity, mathematical checking or automatic accepted knowledge.
tools.license: MIT code and weights; dependencies, compute and separately selected services have distinct terms/costs.
tools.gates: Authorized recordings; fixed model/runtime; compute and retention limits; inspect important names/numbers; distinguish transcription from translation.
tools.proposed_test: One authorized clip with a human reference and silence/noise: measure word/number errors, timing, runtime and storage; second reader locates and checks the cited segment.

tools.documented: PDF manipulation/conversion through desktop, browser and self-hosted API options; open-core product.
tools.proposed_use: Optional preparation for an approved PDF operation missing from existing tools; originals remain immutable and derivatives retain page maps.
tools.boundary: Not authenticity verification or proof of preserved tables, signatures and citations.
tools.license: Root MIT grant has specified directory exceptions with separate licenses; exact edition/component review required.
tools.gates: Check selected edition and dependencies; isolate input/output; bound storage; OCR only when necessary; retain conversion losses and omissions.
tools.proposed_test: One non-sensitive PDF with text/table: verify page mapping, legibility and numbers. A redaction use case additionally needs unrecoverability checks on the delivered derivative.

tools.documented: Command-line audio/video download, metadata and subtitle options.
tools.proposed_use: Acquire one explicitly permitted recording when direct authorized download is unsuitable; retain URL/time/media hash and subtitle provenance.
tools.boundary: No arbitrary harvesting, browser-cookie collection, access-control bypass or claim that subtitles are verified speech.
tools.license: Core repository Unlicense; bundled distributions and dependencies can carry GPLv3+ and other terms.
tools.gates: Pin actual artifact/dependencies; bound source, size and duration; do not execute acquired material; distinguish download from post-processing success.
tools.proposed_test: One permitted media item matches the intended source and integrity record. Denied source or failed post-processing yields failure, not accepted evidence.

tools.documented: Service dashboard, bookmarks, status widgets and integrations with a published security notice.
tools.proposed_use: Use card/navigation patterns in the existing Control Room with evidence age, latest verified result, responsible role and next action.
tools.boundary: A green status tile is not proof of pickup, permission, use or delivery. Do not create a competing dashboard or credential store.
tools.license: GPL-3.0 repository; assess actual copied components before code reuse.
tools.gates: Current record authorization; no service discovery or credential wiring merely from catalog membership; explicit stale/unavailable states.
tools.proposed_test: Human and machine views agree on version/status. Stale source yields a visible gap; protected data is absent from the public output.

tools.documented: Nearby-device file/message transfer over a local network using HTTPS without a third-party relay.
tools.proposed_use: Optional phone-to-laptop transfer, followed by exact hash verification and storage through the existing durable route.
tools.boundary: Not cloud agent pickup, a shared hosted filesystem, permanent backup or automatic bot receipt.
tools.gates: Approved installed clients on reachable intended devices; recipient confirmation; no unattended acceptance or credential/session transfers.
tools.proposed_test: Transfer one harmless fixture, match exact bytes/hash and record the actual receiver path; device arrival is not bot consumption.
owners: existing Codex for an explicitly supplied local file

tools.documented: Visual workflow automation with custom code and service integrations; self-hosted or cloud.
tools.proposed_use: Adapter from an approved event to a real existing submit/status/result API, with receipts returned to the Control Room.
tools.boundary: Not a missing provider API, native conversation access, automatic safe retry or remedy for a frozen chat. Do not duplicate the trusted controller.
tools.license: Sustainable Use License for covered master code; enterprise exceptions. Intended internal/hosted/customer-facing use needs checking.
tools.gates: Callable API and independent credential custody; operation IDs; concurrency/time/cost limits; reconciled unknown outcomes; no self-approval.
tools.proposed_test: One event to approved test endpoints with one effect; restart after interrupted return without duplicating it; compare owner interventions and cost with current transport.

tools.documented: Photo/video management with albums, metadata, duplicate prevention and search.
tools.proposed_use: Organize permitted scene imagery while preserving an independent original-image/camera/coordinate manifest.
tools.boundary: Not Gaussian reconstruction, camera calibration, geometric truth, spatial querying or a sole backup.
tools.license: AGPL-3.0 repository; selected distribution/service terms remain separate.
tools.gates: Approved scene media only; exclude unrelated personal-photo and identity workflows; verify exports, permissions and original-byte preservation.
tools.proposed_test: Round-trip a permitted scene set unchanged, retain image-to-camera links, and verify second-consumer retrieval; test spatial correctness separately.

tools.documented: Collaborative documents, wikis and projects; Notion alternative.
tools.proposed_use: Human draft authoring only if reviewed exports go to the existing authoritative reference/evidence store.
tools.boundary: Not a competing memory database, automatic team learning or authority to replace accepted findings.
tools.license: AGPLv3 repository; selected cloud/AI components need their own assessment.
tools.gates: A proven authoring need; faithful export and current permissions; one-way reviewed publication; no bulk migration this milestone.
tools.proposed_test: Draft/export one non-sensitive note with citations and review state intact; retrieve the accepted version from the existing catalog without a competing current copy.

tools.documented: Human resume/CV builder with templates and structured export; older repository address redirects to the canonical project.
tools.proposed_use: At most a generic structured-data/presentation design reference; no CV-builder integration justified.
tools.boundary: Human employment resumes do not supply agent operation state, permissions, receipts or successor continuity.
tools.gates: Reconsider only for a real human CV or separately justified rendering need.
tools.proposed_test: None for this milestone; retain the non-adoption reason rather than repeat the name-based comparison.

reuse_record_proposal.rule: Success creates a candidate method; failure creates evidence and a scoped correction proposal. Review and current access are required before reuse.

librarian.authority: No signing, scheduling, specialist adjudication or new artifact access.

next_step: Finish the active correction closeout. Later select one real input gap and a bounded comparison; do not install this list as a bundle.
gaussian: Media organization can support but cannot replace lawful scenes, camera data, reconstruction, viewer/query and second-consumer grounded reuse.
